_comment: Copy this file to profile.json and fill in your details. profile.json is gitignored and never committed.
_location_note: Legacy top-level field. Still honoured for backward compatibility — profiles that only set this key render exactly as before. New installs should also fill 'location_facts' below and let 'location_strategy_defaults' choose what each artifact renders.

location_facts._comment: Truthful source data referenced by the location resolver. Not directly rendered — 'location_strategy_defaults' and per-role 'location_strategy' decide which fact goes where.

location_presentations._comment: Candidate-owned labels reused by the resolver's remote_label and custom:<key> strategies. Add custom entries for narratives you use across roles.

custom.eu_timezone: Relocating to an EU timezone shortly

location_strategy_defaults._comment: Default strategy per rendering context. Per-role 'location_strategy' in roles/<id>.json overrides these. Supported values: inherit, hide, remote_label, current_residence, country_only, ats_location, role_location, custom:<key>, generated_role_specific.

relocation: Open to EU/UK relocation with visa sponsorship
_relocation_note: ATS metadata only. Used to answer 'are you open to relocation?' style form fields. Not shown on the CV; use 'openness' for the CV banner.
openness: Open to fully remote roles globally and relocation for the right opportunity.
_openness_note: Optional. Shown on the CV banner under the headline. Per-role roles/<id>.json can override. Leave empty to omit the banner entirely.

cv_display._comment: Optional. Suppress display-only fields from generated PDFs without touching raw profile values used by ATS forms. Each flag must be a JSON boolean (true/false). Flags default to true if omitted.

headline: Senior Software Engineer — Python · Distributed Systems · AI
summary: 7+ years building production Python systems across distributed architectures, data platforms, and AI/LLM evaluation workflows. Open to remote EMEA/US roles.

cv_instructions._comment: Optional. Rendering instructions applied to every generated CV. Omit the block or leave summary_closing_line empty to render the summary as-is.
cv_instructions._summary_closing_line_note: Optional. When set, this string is appended verbatim as the final sentence of the CV summary paragraph (with a single leading space). Idempotent: re-runs do not duplicate the line if the summary already ends with it.

experience._type_note: Optional. One of: employment, open_source, consulting, contract. Defaults to 'employment'. Entries with type 'open_source' render under the Projects section instead of Work Experience.

experience.company_line: Company Name · Industry · Location · Start – End
experience._tech_stack_note: Optional. Verbatim comma-joined tech list rendered as a 'Tech Stack:' line below the role's bullets. Omit to render as before.

_additional_experience_note: Optional. Older/minor roles rendered as a single condensed line prefixed 'Earlier experience:' and joined by ' · ', to preserve page budget. Omit or set to [] to suppress. Per-role roles/<id>.json can override; set [] there to suppress for a specific submission.

yolo_mode._comment: Autonomous submission mode. Disabled by default. Set authorization_key to the output of: python -c "import hashlib; print(hashlib.sha256('career-agent-yolo:<your-email>'.encode()).hexdigest()[:32])"
